customer-inc: Hey team — we're seeing streamed responses cut off mid-event and then double-billed tokens after our client reconnects automatically. Repro below, billing portal shows two line items for the same stream. Help?

maya: Sorry you're hitting this, we'll take a look. Can you paste the original request_id / session_id and approximate timestamps? Also: is the client doing an automatic retry after the 429?

customer-inc: request_id=rc_20260315_92; session_id=sess_7a9c; first observed at 2026-03-15T14:02:12Z. Client does automatic reconnect (we use polyfill lib with backoff). We see SSE stop with a 429, the client reconnects and resumes, but billing shows tokens counted twice. Minimal repro curl: 

```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer OUR_KEY" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  "https://api.redwood-inference.dev/v1/stream?model=rw-2" \
  -d '{"prompt":"(long conversation)", "stream": true, "session_id":"sess_7a9c"}'
```

maya: Thanks. Adding ops/eng. @sam @elena FYI.

ops-bot: trace: rc_20260315_92 stream_id=sess_7a9c -> upstream returned 429, headers: {"X-Rate-Limit-Remaining":"0","Retry-After":"30"} at 2026-03-15T14:02:28Z :warning:

sam: Looking into logs. Quick question: did the client receive final `event: done` or was the connection abruptly closed? If closed mid-event we might be creating a new session on reconnect which could lead to duplicate accounting.

customer-inc: It was abrupt. Client got a 429 response chunk and then re-opened a new connection, same session_id was included by the client in payload but we see two distinct server-side internal session guids in the logs.

customer-inc: Snippet of server-side tail (redacted):

```
[14:02:27Z] conn=lk_99 session_internal=I-55 recv_chunk len=512 tokens=256
[14:02:28Z] conn=lk_99 session_internal=I-55 send=429 "rate limit"
[14:02:29Z] conn=lk_105 session_internal=I-78 session_id=sess_7a9c connect
[14:02:30Z] conn=lk_105 session_internal=I-78 resume_requested=true tokens_already_sent_est=240
[14:02:30Z] conn=lk_105 session_internal=I-78 count_tokens: add 240 -> billed 480
```

sam: OK that log is gold. Root cause hypothesis: when the upstream returns 429 we currently close the internal session (I-55) but keep the token billing entry. On reconnect we create a fresh internal session (I-78) and there is no cross-session deduping keyed only by `session_id` — we key dedupe by internal session guid. So tokens already delivered get counted again.

elena: From billing side I can confirm two entries for the same customer/timeframe and same session_id, invoice shows duplicate token lines. We'll prepare a provisional credit but need list of affected request_ids.

sam: Short-term mitigation: clients should reuse a stable `client_provided_session_id` header on reconnect and set `X-Stream-Resume-Token` with the last event-id if available. We'll add a runtime opt to honor resume headers for an immediate patch. Long-term: runtime needs to perform cross-session token attribution dedupe by `client_provided_session_id` + stream offset.

maya: Can you put together a repro checklist I can send to the customer? Also need an ETA for a hotfix.

sam: Repro checklist: 1) open SSE stream with `session_id=sess_*` and consume a few tokens, 2) trigger rate limit by hitting quota boundary or injecting a short burst to force 429, 3) allow client to reconnect with same `session_id` automatically, 4) check billing ledger for duplicate accounting lines tied to request_id. Patch plan: hotfix to treat `client_provided_session_id` as a primary dedupe key and ignore token adds if we see overlap in recent 60s. I can PR and ship to staging today, prod patch tomorrow EOD PST.

customer-inc: We'll try client-side workarounds in the meantime. If you can suggest a client header to set to reduce risk that would help.

sam: Use header `X-Client-Session-Id: sess_7a9c` and `X-Prefer-No-Retry-On-429: 1` while we patch. That prevents automatic reconnects for a short window and stops duplicate charges. Also add `Last-Event-Id` handling to resume without re-billing.

customer-inc: Applied `X-Client-Session-Id` and set backoff to not retry on 429 for now — looks good in preliminary test, no duplicate line in ledger for the retry case. :white_check_mark:

elena: I've created billing adjustment ticket BILL-3432 and queued a credit for rc_20260315_92. Will update when done.

maya: Action items: ENG (sam) - PR for dedupe by client session id and resume token handling (ship to prod by 2026-03-16 EOD). Billing (elena) - issue credit and backfill detection for last 72h affected streams. Support (maya) - follow up with customer and confirm refund.

ops-bot: created jira RW-STREAM-987 linked to BILL-3432 by maya

maya: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread open until the refund is confirmed and prod patch is live. :pray:
